name: create-skill
description: Create or update a repo skill with OmniRoute compatibility — scaffold SKILL.md + references/, handler.ts, omniskill.json, frontmatter omniroute block, and Compatibility section. Use when adding a new skill or converting an existing one to omniskill.

action.description: 'scaffold' returns file templates; 'validate' checks the four-file contract; 'update-plan' diffs contract impact and states the bump.

name.description: Skill dir name, lowercase kebab-case. Required.

bump.description: Version advice for update-plan. Contract change = minor; content-only = none.
